caption: The video captures a close-up, dimly lit view of a person playing a classical nylon-string guitar. The wooden top, rosette, and round sound hole sit at left-center, while the fretboard runs diagonally to the right, out of focus. The right hand hovers over the strings near the sound hole, and the left hand's fretting fingers appear as a blurred shape over the neck. The right hand repeats a plucking cycle, the index finger extending to touch the strings and then curling back while the thumb rests near the lower strings. The left hand shifts its placement along the neck, pressing and lifting to change the fretted note. The guitar and hands hold roughly the same position, with the fingers and small neck shifts doing most of the moving amid a slight handheld wobble. This continuous playing is already underway and carries through to the end.
